title: American's Big Shakeup, Lufthansa's Brutal Week, and a Flight to Buenos Aires That Barely Left the Ground
summary: American Airlines cleans house — a longtime COO exits with a severance that looks a lot like a firing, and the airline finally kills off its last true first-class cabin. Lufthansa gets hit from three directions at once: job cuts, a canceled city incentive, and a Boeing delay so bad the plane it ordered a decade later beat it to the gate. Plus, a JSX growth play, a lavatory that ruined a 10-hour flight, and Trump's air traffic control claims get fact-checked by his own pilot's competition.
